message:
This PR enables the Biome rule correctness.noUnusedImports across the monorepo and fixes all resulting unused import violations.

- Issue: https://github.com/liam-hq/liam/issues/2315
- Requested by: Hirotaka Miyagi (@MH4GF)
- Link to Devin run: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/6de6d025e08c4175a87963aafac13405

Changes:
- Enable noUnusedImports="error" in frontend/internal-packages/configs/biome.jsonc
- Remove unused imports in:
  - frontend/packages/erd-core/src/features/erd/components/ERDRenderer/DiffMode.stories.tsx
  - frontend/packages/erd-core/src/features/erd/components/ERDRenderer/ErdRenderer.stories.tsx
  - frontend/packages/cli/src/cli/erdCommand/runPreprocess.test.ts
  - frontend/apps/app/components/SessionDetailPage/components/Chat/components/TimelineItem/components/QueryResultMessage/QueryResultMessage.tsx
  - frontend/apps/app/app/(app)/app/(with-project-and-branch)/projects/[projectId]/ref/[branchOrCommit]/layout.tsx

Notes:
- Lint (pnpm lint) passes locally after these changes.
- PR remains in Draft as requested.
